links.outcome: Span-level precision and recall of PHI de-identification against gold-standard annotations
links.effect: Best distilled model reached micro-averaged precision 0.89 and recall 0.88; macro-averaged per-category recall 0.81 vs 0.90 for the cloud teacher, so some PHI is missed.
links.quote: Our best distilled model reaches micro-averaged span-level precision of 0.89 and recall of 0.88 while running on standard workstation hardware.

links.outcome: Cross-dataset generalization of de-identification models across institutions and PHI categories
links.effect: Diversity-trained models generalized well on universal structured PHI categories, but institution-specific entities remained hard to transfer in both directions.
links.quote: Cross-dataset evaluation shows that diversity-trained models generalize well on universal structured PHI categories, while institution-specific entities remain hard to transfer in both directions, which suggests pairing broad-coverage models with specialized models for high-volume, semi-structured note types.

unlisted_practices: Teacher-student distillation of LLMs into locally deployable small language models for on-premise PHI de-identification
Set-cover diversity sampling of demographic and document-type strata to build a de-identification benchmark

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a new dataset (SHIELD) and distilled small language models for clinical text de-identification, evaluating model performance across strata rather than testing an organizational deployment practice.
